posts.title: Problems of Interpretation
posts.description: Artwork: Maithreyi Anyone who undertakes a general survey of the political and cultural landscape of our time is bound to leave with a sense of apprehension. Throughout the world, we not only observe the rise of political extremism, irrespective of conservative or liberal dispositions, but also the prevalence of a looming confusion, created by a social milieu where knowledge is found in abundance.

posts.title: Programming as Art
posts.description: The common perception towards programming is often colored by a sense of begrudging monotony.
